description: The HOUSE VIEW as of the last Friday close: a weekly report's call, what would change it (checked live: fired or not), scenarios, tables. No id lists editions. For the live tape now, get_macro_picture. Deep-dives: Analyst until 4 weeks old.

edition.description: Listing only: 'weekly', 'quick', 'custom' (every custom deep-dive), or one custom topic such as 'chips'.

id.description: Edition id: '2026-W40' (Weekly), '2026-W40-quick', or a custom deep-dive's '2026-W40-<topic>' ('2026-W40-chips', '2026-W41-brazil'). Omit to list the editions instead.

include_sections.description: With id: add each section's narrative, lede and callouts in page order. Default false.

include_tables.description: With id: add every table row, chart series and the week-ahead calendar. Default false.

limit.description: Listing only: how many editions, newest first.

triggers_only.description: With id: only the lines that carry a machine-checkable condition, each with its live trigger status. Wins over include_*. Default false.

name: get_report
